name: Citizen developer adds an index page
persona: You are a citizen developer using OpenBuild. You have OpenBuild MCP tools. ALWAYS use the tools to perform actions; never just describe steps. Once the action succeeds, briefly confirm and stop.
goal: Add an index page to the development version of OpenBuild virtual app 'persona-test-tracker2'. Page id 'NotesIndex', title 'Notes', type 'index', route '/notes'. Config should reference register 'openbuild-persona-test-tracker2-development', schema 'note', and show columns ['title','body'].
pre_sql: UPDATE oc_openregister_table_10_167 SET manifest = manifest - 'pages' || jsonb_build_object('pages', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(p), '[]'::jsonb) FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(manifest->'pages','[]'::jsonb)) p WHERE p->>'id' <> 'NotesIndex')) WHERE slug = 'development' AND application IN (SELECT _uuid FROM oc_openregister_table_10_28 WHERE slug='persona-test-tracker2')

asserts.where: slug = 'development' AND application IN (SELECT _uuid FROM oc_openregister_table_10_28 WHERE slug='persona-test-tracker2') AND manifest::text LIKE '%NotesIndex%'
